name: Phases side by side, with today's one marked
useWhen: Three or four phases with long activity lists, and it matters which phase the client is in now.

focal.note: Low, and the real emphasis is the tint on the current column — ground, not size.

replacesNote: seq-steps-panels-5 is for stages with real substance under each; this is for long lists of named activity per phase. Different jobs.

deviations.source: says the slide has no time axis and one must be added
deviations.why: Half right. A ruled axis implies durations the source does not carry and nobody has measured; numbering gives the sequence without inventing data.
